County population from the Gross County Product reports

Source: R/reports.R
knbs_county_population.Rd

Each county's 2019 census population and KNBS's projections for the years since, with land area and 2019 population density, as printed in the Gross County Product reports - the annual county-year population denominators for per-capita figures.

Usage

knbs_county_population(
  edition = "latest",
  cache = knbs_option("cache"),
  refresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

edition

"latest", "all", or edition years such as 2024.

cache

Whether to use the local cache.

refresh

Whether to re-download the report and re-extract.

Value

A knbs_report_table tibble with columns geo_code, county, period, value, measure, unit, edition, table_id and source_id.

Details

measure says what each row is: "population_census" (the 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census), "population_projected", "land_area" (square kilometres) and "population_density" (persons per square kilometre, 2019). The 2025 edition projects 2020-2024, the 2024 edition 2020-2023; a newer edition's projections supersede an older one's.

See also

knbs_gcp(); knbs_get_indicator() for the census tables.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
population <- knbs_county_population()
}
